## Outcome and risk

Describe the observable behavior, affected surfaces, risk level, and what must remain unchanged.

## Test and validation evidence

List focused regression tests and broader checks. Record skipped or unavailable checks with the exact reason; do not report them as passing.

## Documentation and project memory

List updated canonical docs/generated artifacts/project-memory files, or explain why the change has no durable documentation impact.

## Deployment and rollback

Describe Azure/runtime impact, expected test and production gates, rollback constraints, and any cost or permission change.

## Residual risks and blockers

List remaining risks, external blockers, and repair attempts. Write `None` only after reviewing the final diff and delivery evidence.
